arxiv-2003-00063.title: Bio-Inspired Modality Fusion for Active Speaker Detection
arxiv-2003-00063.creator: Gustavo Assunção *, Nuno Gonçalves, Paulo Menezes
arxiv-2003-00063.description: Abstract Human beings have developed fantastic abilities to integrate information from various sensory sources exploring their inherent complementarity. Perceptual capabilities are therefore heightened, enabling, for instance, the well-known ”cocktail party” and McGurk effects, i.e., speech disambiguation from a panoply of sound signals.

arxiv-2101-01197.title: Stromlo Stellar Tracks: non-solar scaled abundances for massive stars Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , iPython ( Pérez & Granger 2007 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Numpy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ; Harris et al. 2020 ) , scipy ( Jones et al. 200
arxiv-2101-01197.creator: K. Grasha, A. Roy, R. S. Sutherland, L. J. Kewley
arxiv-2101-01197.description: Abstract We present the Stromlo Stellar Tracks, a set of stellar evolutionary tracks, computed by modifying the Modules for Experiments in Stellar Astrophysics (MESA) 1D stellar evolution package, to fit the Galactic Concordance abundances for hot ( T > 8000 \mathrm{T}>8000 K) massive ( ≥ 10 \geq 10 M ⊙ ) Main-Sequence (MS) stars.

arxiv-2105-05885.title: Playing Codenames with Language Graphs and Word Embeddings
arxiv-2105-05885.creator: Divya Koyyalagunta* divyakoyy@gmail.com
arxiv-2105-05885.description: Abstract Although board games and video games have been studied for decades in artificial intelligence research, challenging word games remain relatively unexplored. Word games are not as constrained as games like chess or poker. Instead, word game strategy is defined by the players’ understanding of the way words relate to each other.

arxiv-2109-04006.title: Two-dimensional pentagonal material Penta -PdPSe: A first-principle study
arxiv-2109-04006.creator: A. Bafekry, M. M. Fadlallah, M. Faraji, A. Shafique, H. R. Jappor, I. Abdolhoseini Sarsari, Yee Sin Ang, M. Ghergherehchi
arxiv-2109-04006.description: Abstract Low-symmetry Penta-PdPSe with intrinsic in-plane anisotropy synthesized successfully [P. Li et al., Adv. Mater. , 2102541 (2021)]. Motivated by this experimental discovery, we investigate the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical and thermoelectric properties of PdPSe monolayer via density functional theory calculations.

arxiv-2201-02304.title: Budget aware Few-shot learning via Graph Convolutional Network
arxiv-2201-02304.creator: Shipeng Yan, Songyang Zhang, Xuming He
arxiv-2201-02304.description: Abstract This paper tackles the problem of few-shot learning, which aims to learn new visual concepts from a few examples. A common problem setting in few-shot classification assumes random sampling strategy in acquiring data labels, which is inefficient in practical applications.

arxiv-2301-07229.title: An upper bound and a characterization for Gini’s mean difference based on correlated random variables
arxiv-2301-07229.creator: Roberto Vila, Narayanaswamy Balakrishnan, Helton Saulo
arxiv-2301-07229.description: Abstract In this paper, we obtain an upper bound for the Gini mean difference based on mean, variance and correlation for the case when the variables are correlated. We also derive some closed-form expressions for the Gini mean difference when the random variables have an absolutely continuous joint distribution.

arxiv-2305-08835.title: A multi-state mapping approach to surface hopping
arxiv-2305-08835.creator: Johan E. Runeson, David E. Manolopoulos
arxiv-2305-08835.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Johan E. Runeson, David E. Manolopoulos. We describe a multiple electronic state adaptation of the mapping approach to surface hopping introduced recently by Mannouch and Richardson (J. Our modification treats populations and coherences on an equal footing and is guaranteed to give populations in any electronic basis that tend to the correct quantum–classical equilibrium values in the long-time limit (assuming ergodicity).

arxiv-2307-02394.title: Won’t Get Fooled Again: Answering Questions with False Premises
arxiv-2307-02394.creator: Shengding Hu, Yifan Luo, Huadong Wang, Xingyi Cheng, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
arxiv-2307-02394.description: Abstract Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have shown unprecedented potential in various fields, especially as the backbones for question-answering (QA) systems. However, they tend to be easily deceived by tricky questions such as “How many eyes does the sun have?”. Such frailties of PLMs often allude to the lack of knowledge within them.

arxiv-2311-10617.title: Astronomical Images Quality Assessment with Automated Machine Learning
arxiv-2311-10617.creator: Olivier Parisot, Pierrick Bruneau, Patrik Hitzelberger Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) 5 Avenue des Hauts-Fourneaux, 4362 Esch-sur-Alzette - Luxembourg olivier.parisot@list.lu
arxiv-2311-10617.description: Abstract Electronically Assisted Astronomy consists in capturing deep sky images with a digital camera coupled to a telescope to display views of celestial objects that would have been invisible through direct observation. This practice generates a large quantity of data, which may then be enhanced with dedicated image editing software after observation sessions.

arxiv-2403-03794.title: Convergence rate for a regularized scalar conservation law
arxiv-2403-03794.creator: Billel Guelmame and Haroune Houamed
arxiv-2403-03794.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Billel Guelmame and Haroune Houamed. This work revisits a recent finding by the first author concerning the local convergence of a regularized scalar conservation law. We significantly improve the original statement by establishing a global convergence result within the Lebesgue spaces L loc ∞ ​ ( ℝ + , L p ​ ( ℝ ) ) L^{\infty}_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^{+};L^{p}(\mathbb{R})) , for any p ∈ [ 1 , ∞ ) p\in[1,\infty) , as the regularization parameter ℓ \ell approaches zero.

arxiv-2404-11750.title: Robust Quasi-Bound States in the continuum: Accidental and Symmetry-Protected Variants in Dielectric Metasurfaces
arxiv-2404-11750.creator: Hicham Mangach, 1,* Abdelhaq Belkacem, 2 Younes Achaoui, 2 Abdenbi Bouzid, 2 Boris Gralak, 1 and Sebastien Guenneau 3,4
arxiv-2404-11750.description: Abstract Recently, man-made dielectric materials composed of finite-sized dielectric constituents have emerged as a promising platform for quasi-bound states in the continuum (QBICs). These states allow for an extraordinary confinement of light within regions smaller than the wavelength scale. Known for their exceptional quality factors, they have become crucial assets across a diverse array of applications.

arxiv-2410-16330.title: End-to-End Transformer-based Automatic Speech Recognition for Northern Kurdish: A Pioneering Approach
arxiv-2410-16330.creator: Abdulhady Abas Abdullah, Shima Tabibian, Hadi Veisi, Aso Mahmudi, Tarik Rashid
arxiv-2410-16330.description: Abstract Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for low-resource languages remains a challenging task due to limited training data. This paper introduces a comprehensive study exploring the effectiveness of Whisper, a pre-trained ASR model, for Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji) an under-resourced language spoken in the Middle East. We investigate three fine-tuning strategies: vanilla, specific parameters, and additional modules.

arxiv-2505-15273.title: Non-weight modules over gap- p p Virasoro algebras
arxiv-2505-15273.creator: Chengkang Xu, Fulin Chen, Shaobin Tan
arxiv-2505-15273.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study non-weight modules over gap- p p Virasoro algebras, including Whittaker modules, 𝒰 ⁡ ( ℂ ​ L 0 ) \mathcal{U}(\mathbb{C}L_{0}) -free modules and their tensor products. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for universal Whittaker modules to be irreducible and study the structure of irreducible Whittaker modules.

arxiv-2509-24057.creator: Alex Behakanira Tumwesigye, Mahadi Ddamulira, Prosper Kaggwa

arxiv-2601-08522.title: Degree bounds for linear differential equations and recurrences
arxiv-2601-08522.creator: Louis Gaillard
arxiv-2601-08522.description: Abstract Linear differential equations and recurrences reveal many properties about their solutions. Therefore, these equations are well-suited for representing solutions and computing with special functions. We identify a large class of existing algorithms that compute such representations as a linear relation between the iterates of an elementary operator known as a pseudo-linear map .

arxiv-2601-21992.title: Short Strings in Three-Dimensional Anti-de Sitter Space: from Weak to Strong Coupling
arxiv-2601-21992.creator: Simon Ekhammar, Nikolay Gromov, Bogdan Stefański, jr, Charles Thull
arxiv-2601-21992.description: Abstract We numerically solve the conjectured Quantum Spectral Curve for strings on AdS 3 × {}_{3}\times S 3 × {}^{3}\times T 4 with R–R charge from weak to strong coupling. At strong coupling, the spectrum organises into flat-space string mass levels with universal square-root scaling in the string tension at leading order, and additional Kaluza-Klein fine-splitting at subleading order.

pmc-10671646.title: The Homeodomain–Leucine Zipper Subfamily I Contributes to Leaf Age- and Time-Dependent Resistance to Pathogens in Arabidopsis thaliana
pmc-10671646.creator: Nami Maeda, Fuko Matsuta, Takaya Noguchi, Ayumu Fujii, Hikaru Ishida, Yudai Kitagawa, Atsushi Ishikawa
pmc-10671646.description: In Arabidopsis thaliana (Arabidopsis), nonhost resistance (NHR) is influenced by both leaf age and the moment of inoculation. While the circadian clock and photoperiod have been linked to the time-dependent regulation of NHR in Arabidopsis, the mechanism underlying leaf age-dependent NHR remains unclear. In this study, we investigated leaf age-dependent NHR to Pyricularia oryzae in Arabidopsis.

pmc-11455892.title: Power flow analysis using quantum and digital annealers: a discrete combinatorial optimization approach
pmc-11455892.creator: Zeynab Kaseb, Matthias Möller, Pedro P. Vergara, Peter Palensky
pmc-11455892.description: Power flow (PF) analysis is a foundational computational method to study the flow of power in an electrical network. This analysis involves solving a set of non-linear and non-convex differential-algebraic equations. State-of-the-art solvers for PF analysis, therefore, face challenges with scalability and convergence, specifically for large-scale and/or ill-conditioned cases characterized by high penetration of renewable energy sources, among others.

pmc-11470875.title: Predictors of non-adherence to an early in-hospital rehabilitation program after surgery for hip fracture in a co-managed orthogeriatric unit
pmc-11470875.creator: Roberto Presta, Enrico Brunetti, Valeria Quaranta, Silvio Raspo, Paola Cena, Giulia Carignano, Martina Bonetto, Chiara Busso, Gianluca Isaia, Marco Marabotto, Giuseppe Massazza, Mario Bo
pmc-11470875.description: BackgroundHip fracture is a common event in older adults, leading to an increased risk of mortality, disability, and higher healthcare costs. Early in-hospital rehabilitation after surgery within orthogeriatric units may improve outcomes with limited incident complications even in the oldest old.

pmc-12581484.title: Patterns and perceived risks of personal auditory device use among medical students: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12581484.creator: Pranil Shah, Prashant Dave, Labhita Das, Utkarsh Shah, Niraj Bharadva
pmc-12581484.description: ObjectiveThe World Health Organization estimates that 1.1 billion people are at risk of developing noise-induced hearing loss from the unsafe use of Personal Auditory Devices (PADs). The use of these devices has grown exponentially, placing young adults at high risk of recreational NIHL and other ear-related health problems.

pmc-12831260.title: Nitric oxide-releasing nanocarriers integrated with ginsenoside compound K in dissolvable microneedles for androgenetic alopecia
pmc-12831260.creator: Guanghui Sun, Jianlin Liu, Guorui Jin, Jing Zhao, Xiaoyang Li, Xueqing Yu, Yu Mi
pmc-12831260.description: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is recognized as a prevalent androgen-mediated disorder characterized by progressive follicular miniaturization and irreversible hair loss, primarily driven by the pathological elevation of dihydrotestosterone (DHT) that disrupts hair follicle microenvironment and induces follicular cells damage. This condition frequently results in profound psychosocial distress and diminished quality of life among affected individuals.
